grounded.query: Lewis et al. retrieve passages with a dense retriever. According to Edge et al., what kind of question does that style of retrieval fail on, and what do they build instead?
Compare RAG-Sequence and RAG-Token from Document A with the way GraphRAG answers a global question from Document B. Which steps are parametric and which are non-parametric?
Document C describes the ship's archive. Which of the failure modes of naive RAG named in Documents A and B would affect an exact part-number lookup in that archive?
How does each of Documents A and B evaluate answer quality, and which of those measures could be applied to the astrogation logs in Document C?
What does GraphRAG add on top of vector retrieval, and which sentence in Document C would most benefit from that addition?

negative.query: What xenon flow rate (in mg/s) does the Noosphere's ion thruster use at cruise, according to the archive?
What Recall@5 does the paper report for the RAG-Token model on the Natural Questions test set when retrieval is replaced by HNSW?
Which hyperspace propulsion code does Edge et al. recommend for deployment of GraphRAG on starships?
